set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

vlan-id [parameter3].explanation: Configure VLAN IDs for interface units.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify VLAN.

family ethernet-switching native-vlan-id.explanation: Configures the native VLAN ID for untagged traffic on an Ethernet interface in Junos, where `[parameter3]` specifies the VLAN ID.

parameters.name: native-vlan-id
parameters.explanation: The ID number of the local VLAN.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set system radius-server [parameter1].explanation: Configures a RADIUS server with the specified parameters, such as IP address, port, and shared secret, for network authentication and accounting purposes.

port [parameter2].explanation: Configures the RADIUS server with `[parameter1]` as the server address and `[parameter2]` as the port number for authentication and accounting communication.

parameters.name: port
parameters.explanation: Port number for the RADIGUS server.

secret [parameter3].explanation: Configure the IP address, port and shared key of the RADIUS server.

accounting-port [parameter2].explanation: Configure the billing port for the RADIGUS server.

set protocols ospf area [parameter1].explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

interface [parameter2].explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.

set access address-assignment pool [para.explanation: This command fragment configures an address-assignment pool named `[parameter1]` for dynamic IP address allocation in Junos.

family inet network [parameter2]/[parame.explanation: Configure the network address and subnet mask for the distribution pool.

family inet dhcp-attributes router [para.explanation: The address of the router that configures DHCP properties.

family inet dhcp-attributes name-server.explanation: Configures the name server address for DHCP properties.

set system login user [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

class [parameter2].explanation: Configure the type of system login user.

set system authentication-order [paramet.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system.

set system radius-options authentication.explanation: Configure the start and stop of RADIUS authentication and accounting.

set system radius-options accounting [pa.explanation: Configure the start and stop of RADIUS accounting.

set access profile [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment sets an access profile in Junos, defining a named profile (parameter1) to configure security policies, authentication, or authorization settings for network access.

parameters.name: profile-name
parameters.explanation: Accesses the name of the profile.

authentication-order [parameter2].explanation: Configures the authentication order for access to the profile.

accounting [parameter2].explanation: The `accounting [parameter2]` command in Junos enables or configures traffic accounting for specific parameters, such as source/destination addresses or interfaces, for monitoring and analysis.

set system login class [parameter1].explanation: This Junos command fragment defines a login class named `[parameter1]`, specifying permissions and access levels for users assigned to this class.

parameters.name: class-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the login class.

authentication [parameter2].explanation: The command `authentication [parameter2]` in Junos configures the authentication method or key for a protocol or interface, where `[parameter2]` specifies the authentication type or key.

parameters.name: authentication-method
parameters.explanation: The authentication method, for example, local.

authorization [parameter2].explanation: The command `authorization [parameter2]` in Junos configures user authorization settings, specifying the method or order for verifying user permissions.

parameters.name: authorization-method
parameters.explanation: The authorization method, such as RADIUS.

set forwarding-options dhcp-relay server.explanation: Configure the DHCP trunking server group.
